notes.title: April 2025 - Dungeons, DCJam2025 and more!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Lots of work done this month, even if the bullet list is a bit short. 2 dungeons completed and another one started, fast travel system and more implemented! This month, I'll be trying to wrap up the castle dungeon, but also Dungeon Crawl Jam 2025 is coming up and I'll be participating. It's likely to be a slow month for R&R due to that but it will be a nice break for me to try out new things in the engine and play some sweet dungeon crawlers, then get back at it. Check out the R&R updates below:

[list]
[*] Fast travel system has been created. You'll have to discover the ability to use this magic first and through exploring you'll find runes that allow you to teleport to different areas. I'm thinking I might even add some secret one, that will teleport you to difficult and or optional dungeons or areas.
[*] Completed the sunken ship dungeon
[*] Completed a spider dungeon
[*] New spell/related quest added to the game
[*] Expanded snowfields map
[*] Began work on a side dungeon related to the Northlands 
[*] added some props and environmental decorations to older areas to spruce them up a bit
[*] Adjusted item drop rates for better balance
[*] Fixed up some monster animations to look a bit better
[*] Several new props/decorations created for dungeons/maps completed in this update
[*] Multiple enemies created and animated related to completed maps in this update
[/list]

Here is the current state oft Realms & Ruins: Abencor:

[list]
[*] 89 maps w/ 4 cities, overland areas & 11 dungeons 
[*] 180+ NPC's & monsters 
[*] 100+ items & treasures 
[*] Completed main storyline + sidequests (and more to come!)
[/list]

As always, if you like what you see make sure to follow on itch and wishlist on steam, check me out on Bluesky and join the discord too!

notes.title: March 2025, Main Quest Complete! New engine update and more!
notes.content:
The main quest is finally complete! So it's official, the main quest for Realms & Ruins: Abencor is playable from start to finish! I wrapped up some of the final boss area scripting and the credits roll at the end! That is to say, some areas of the game are a bit barebones, so my focus turns to fleshing out side quests, optional dungeons, itemization etc in the final areas of the game and playtesting for balancing. There was also an engine update so I did a full playthrough last night to see if anything broke and everything is good. 

Don't forget you can join my discord here to discuss the game (and future projects) here: https://discord.gg/BRGAEkHxh4

You can also follow me on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/bonedudegamestudios.itch.io

Here's the updates since last month:

notes.title: February 2025 - Final dungeon complete (mostly)! Discord, new skill, bug fixes,
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I'm a bit late this month but I wanted to push through completing the 2 sub-dungeons for the final area of the game. So that means the actual building/scripting for the final dungeon is complete but I still need to complete the final encounter and wrap up the story. I also added moving platforms, new skills, and made tons of bug fixes and optimizations to keep up on things I notice as I test. On top of that, I launched a Discord server for the game, so if you want to chat, give feedback, or just hang out, come join in! Exciting times ahead as I get closer to the finish line! You can join here: https://discord.gg/BRGAEkHxh4

notes.title: January 2025 - Happy new year!
notes.content:
Happy New Year! I had some time off but as always I stayed busy. Continued work on the final dungeon, creating monsters, assets and sourcing music took up much of my time and included many fixes on some previous work. You can see the new in-game main menu in the attached screenshots. More details on my work below:

[list]
[*] Fixed various issues in volcano dungeon boss (boss animations, scripting related to phases)
[*] Made cut scene related to volcano boss
[*] Updated main menu image, is now animated 
[*] Shops now sell torches!
[*] Adjusted prices of some items
[*] Added price labels to shops
[*] Adjusted font and some UI elements on shop screens
[*] Refactored an event script in the Sandstorm Sanctum dungeon to account for errors if the player dies during the event
[*] Refactored an event script in the Orc Camp to reduce script overhead and be more consistent
[*] Fixed death animation on the orc beastmaster which was erroneously using non-death frames 
[*] Fixed a missing switch in Bastion of the Prism
[*] Updated dialogue script to appropriately change sailing skill icon
[*] Fixed a dialogue script in the sea cave to display the appropriate text
[*] Fixed attack animation on zombie sailor to not get stuck in a loop
[*] Fixed death animation on zombie sailor which was erroneously using non-death frames 
[*] Fixed multiple tiles that weren't walkable and should be in sea cave
[*] Fixed multiple tiles that were walkable and shouldn't be in sea cave
[*] Fixed missing tile in sea cave
[*] Made some changes to the sea cave map
[*] Added fog for ambience and changed lighting in the sea cave map
[*] Changed flowing water script in sea cave map 
[*] Fixed some seams on a couple "brick" and "wood" pattern tiles that looked a bit funky if took a really close look
[*] Fixed corner/seams on the ivywood tree model to not overlap and cause graphical artifacts
[*] Sourced music for final dungeon
[*] Created several environment assets for the final dungeon
[*] Began early prototyping for a jumping system. Not sure how far I'll go with it, just playing around and would have to retrofit it to the current game world. Not an issue per se but I want to keep scope creep to a minimum until release
[*] Fix multiple cutscene scripts which weren't properly stopping the playing from moving during the cut scene 
[*] Fixed a script that was erroneously rolling the credits, a remnant of my demo migration
[/list]


That's all! I hope you all had some great holidays and I'll keep working towards full release, hopefully this year. If you like what you see, wishlist or you can check out my itch where I also have a couple other games from some jams and these devlogs:
https://realmsruins.itch.io/realmsandruinsabencor/devlog/863203/jan-2025-happy-new-year

notes.title: December 2024! Light at the end of the tunnel (for the MQ!), New Art, bug fixes
notes.content:
New art assets have been added to Itch and Steam! These were always placeholders and I still may do some tweaking but I like how they came out. I'm nearly finished with the Main Quest, just one dungeon left to go/final boss and story wrap up and the game will be completable from start to finish. After that, testing, cleanup and possibly even more monumental task of expanding out the optional content in the game, which may be just as much work as the main quest but I've got a good workflow going and I could simply say "Done!" whenever I want. I have some time off this month so I'm going to make a big push to finish up the MQ, I'm very close! Here's what I've done the last ~30 days or so:

notes.title: October 2024- Burn baby burn!
notes.content:
hope everyone impacted by the hurricane is safe and doing well. As for this month's update, I continue to grind away at the southern region/volcano dungeon. Here's what I've worked on and continue to work on throughout October:


[list]
[*] I've added 3 new maps tied to the volcano dungeon (work in progress, nearly finished)

[*] I'm also in the process of developing the boss of the dungeon fight with some unique mechanics.

[*]  5+ new monsters are being worked on for the aforementioned dungeon

[*] I started experimenting with some backdrops for the northern mountain, a quick distraction from the volcano work but check out the attached screenshot

[*] Lastly, I'll be experimenting with a new tool to improve sprite animations. I plan to showcase these in my next update if it works out
[/list]

After finishing this current dungeon, I’m considering moving on to the "final" dungeon of the game's critical path. Originally, I planned for 6 dungeons plus a final one to close out the second half, totaling 11 main quest dungeons, before adding optional dungeons and areas. However, I now think keeping it to 3 dungeons and a final one (8 main quest dungeons total) is still ambitious but more manageable, helping to minimize scope creep and burnout. While the "end" is on the horizon, there's still a lot of work ahead—beyond the critical path, I want to create additional optional content to flesh out the world and my vision. I also plan to rework animations (if the new tool works out), and improve the environments by adding more details like plants and decorations to enhance some of the earlier, blander areas.

Thanks for tuning in and don't forget to wishlist if you like what you see and check out my itch page!
https://realmsruins.itch.io/realmsandruinsabencor/devlog/810917/october-2024-burn-baby-burn

notes.title: July 2024 - Game Convention and more!
notes.content:
Things were busy in the last month! In addition to some updates to the primary game, Realms & Ruins: Abencor was accepted to an indie developer contest at a local retro gaming convention. I only had a short time to throw together a demo, but I got it done. I had lots of great feedback, made some local connections and had a ton of fun. 

There was some miscommunication for the actual contest and I got an email back from the organizer that the judges didn't judge all the contestants! I had a great time either way and will be taking the feedback I got and incorporating it into the game. All of this months updates are below!

Main Build

[list]
[*] 6 new underwater creatures created, statted and animated
[*] change default location of hp/mp bar (still draggable) 
[*] Completed new map in water biome
[*] Updated behavior, stats and loot tables of 15 creatures 
[*] Create a vault/storage system. 
[*] Placed vault NPC's and buildings in every  major town (culceth, mandora, ivywood) 
[*] Difficulty adjustment for catacomb enemies - reduce strength of entry level enemies
[/list]


Demo Build (not publicly available at the moment, and I will integrate this into the main game)

[list]
[*] Created multiple snow and ice related tiles
[*] Created frost cave dungeon
[*] Scripted puzzles for frost cave
[*] Created, statted and animated 8 new creatures related to the frost cave 
[*] Added music for frost cave, including music for the boss encounter
[*] Created 3 unique items found in the frost cave (secrets abound!)
[*] Scripted and tested AOE components of a fireball wand
[*] Created mana potion and scripted functionality
[*] Scripted boss encounter for frost cave/demo dungeon
[*] Scripted resistances related to wearing frost armor
[*] Scripted on-hit special effects for enemies in cave
[*] Added snow 
[/list]


Back to work and I'll post another update sometime in August!

notes.title: May 2024! Post DC2024 Jam - Balance fixes, monsters, new dungeon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231707/e13008d6cabfd3115a673a0ed6cfabb918d69d56.png[/img]

Hey everybody! Here with another update! Last month I spent a bit of time doing some post-dcjam2024 fixes to Escaping the Cosmic Abyss, of which I placed 10th out of 167 entries! I'm very proud of my placement and congratulations to everybody else! It was a ton of fun. I'll post a link to the project at the end of this update.

Going to go for more of a list of things I completed this time around. Here's what I got done on Realms & Ruins over the last month:

[b]  Monster Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]  Tuned down defense scaling for all monsters outside of Ivywood.
[*]  Significantly increased monster gold drops, including ones previously that were missing gold drops entirely. Further testing is needed but hopefully it's possible to survive better outside of Ivywood when it comes to your coinpurse
[/list]
   
[b]Location and Map Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Removed some spawning locations in the Orc Cave.
[*]         Fixed navigable grid squares on several maps.
[*]         Fixed script issues in the desert when transitioning maps. 
[/list]
  
[b]  Enemy Behavior:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Adjusted movement frequency and speed for certain enemies.
[*]         Enabled orcs and wargs to actively chase the player.
[/list] 

[b]    Game Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Changed how the desert mechanic works and made the compass more useful. 
[/list]

[b]    Model and Animation Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Modified the priest model to align with other character models.
[*]         Fixed the Culceth Merchant 2 idle animation.
[*]         Created and animated 5 new monsters.
[/list]
 
[b]    Player Experience Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Increased player starting speed to be less sluggish.
[*]         Modified Field of View (FOV)/Camera height to better align with Dungeon Crawler conventions, improving visibility of adjacent tiles.
[*]         Changed key bindings: turning to Q and E, and strafing to A and D. 
[/list]

[b]    UI Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Moved some UI elements to temporarily resolve issues with disappearing skill/quickslot bars.
[/list] 
[b]
    New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Added a mermaid to Mermaid Rock (additional content planned). 
[/list]

[b]    Dungeon Development:[/b]
[list]
[*]         Began work on the Sea Cave dungeon. 
[/list]


That's all! I'm going to keep grinding away. Stay tuned for more updates next month!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467200/Realms_and_Ruins_Abencor/

Check out my 10th place Dungeon Crawler Jam 2024 Entry and all the others here:
https://itch.io/jam/dcjam2024/results

notes.title: February Update: Sailing into uncharted waters!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231707/49c454d151c2094d8e2a7fa7c469093fa6aefc52.gif[/img]
Hey folks! Another update here with a quick update on what's been going down in February:

Diving into the Second Half: Been hard at work expanding the second half of the game. Writing up new storylines, challenges, and all that good stuff. 

Testing the Waters with Sailing: Exciting times! I've laid down the groundwork for a sailing system. Soon, you'll be able to set sail and explore beyond the shores. New territories, here we come!

Splashing into the Depths: We're going underwater, folks! Building out a cool underwater area filled with secrets and challenges. Dive in and discover what's hidden beneath the surface. This will be one of the main areas for the second half of the game!

Bugs - I've squashed all the bugs I can think of and have playtested the current state of the game in various ways to make sure there's no conflicts or issues. I'm still waiting on a few engine bugs but can continue work until those are complete.

Peek at the Goods: Attached a few teaser images to give you a taste of what's coming up. Hope you like what you see!

Thanks for riding along on this solo dev adventure. More updates headed your way soon. Until then, happy crawling!

notes.title: October 2023 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Time for the October update!

 Here are some of the key highlights:

1. Character Model Death Animations:

    I've been working hard on adding death animations to the 30+ monsters so far that are in the game. Some examples are attached to this update! I think it makes the game look much better than the enemies just poofing from mid air. You'll also notice a "slashing" animation I have added to give some player feedback when attacking.

2. More building and scripting

    I continue to build and script the current 3 areas for this leg of the adventure. Not much to show, but definitely more to come!

3. Halloween Game Jam:

    I took a small break to participate in the RPG in a Box October Game Jam. I learned some new stuff and some fun things I plan to implement into Realms & Ruins: Abencor.

     My spooky game jam entry can be found here: https://realmsruins.itch.io/cursed-realm-all-hallows-mystery

    RPG in a Box October Game Jam info here: https://itch.io/jam/rpg-in-a-box-october-game-jam

That's all for this month! Looking forward to more next month!

notes.title: September 2023 update!
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

It's time for our September update for Realms & Ruins Abencor! Here's a rundown of the progress I've made:

1. Cityscapes Complete: The foundations of the world has been laid! All three primary cities are now standing tall, each with its unique charm and character. The final of the major 3 cities are in place, but just need some NPC's, quests and scripting. 

2. New Dungeons: The main story dungeons are taking shape in the surrounding areas of the major cities. They are in the process of being built, with monsters created (including boss encounters!). 

3. Resistance/Weakness System A significant breakthrough in combat dynamics! I've successfully implemented the early stages of a resistance/weakness system, adding a layer of tactical depth to encounters. Say farewell to boring old snake bites - they now wield the power of venom while being resistant to the same damage type. Expect more to come as I flesh out this system with regards to monsters and player equipment.

4. Embracing Originality in Art: After much contemplation, I've chosen to break free from AI-generated art because of it's current legal grey area for commercial works. While the only AI art I've incorporated is 3 screens - The Main Title Screen, Loading Image, and Death Image - They have all been changed to include non-AI art that is licensed appropriately. I will be updating my itch and Steam page logos and pictures to reflect this by the next update.

These updates mark significant milestones in the development of Realms & Ruins Abencor. As always, I eagerly await your thoughts and look forward to sharing more exciting news in the coming months.

Until next time, adventurers, may your blades stay sharp and your spells hit true!

You can also follow my updates on itch:
https://realmsruins.itch.io/realmsandruinsabencor/devlog/587782/september-update-more-progress-new-systems
